area.projection: Local metric ENU approximation on sphere R=6371000: east = (lon-lon0)*R*cos(lat0)*pi/180, north = (lat-lat0)*R*pi/180. Scene maps north to -z. Vertical: scene y = (elevation - DEM min) * verticalScale.
